name: Console Key
summary: At the Venture Company digsite in the Barrens, Tinkerer Sniggles holds the Console Key. It unlocks the main control terminal and lets the samophlange be removed once the apparatus is shut down.

sections.title: Securing the Apparatus
sections.body: The Venture Company runs an industrial outpost in the northern Barrens. Its steam-driven machinery depends on a device called a samophlange. The console is locked against unauthorized hands, and only Tinkerer Sniggles, the chief technician on site, carries the Console Key. The key opens the terminal casing so the rig can be powered down.

sections.title: Shutting Down the Rig
sections.body: After the auxiliary valves are turned and the apparatus cools to a stop, the Console Key cuts the final circuits. Turning it drains the terminal's remaining power and unlocks its housing, letting the samophlange be pried from the machinery.

faq.q: What does the Console Key unlock?
faq.answer: The Console Key unlocks the main control console at the Venture Company rig in the northern Barrens. Once the machinery is idle, it drains power from the terminal and exposes the samophlange.
Tinkerer Sniggles carries the Console Key. The Venture Company engineer stays in a hut just northeast of the main console apparatus.

faq.q: Why is the console locked in the first place?
aliases: why do i need a key
faq.answer: The Venture Company locks the terminal to keep rivals and unruly workers from interfering with its machinery or taking valuable parts like the samophlange.

faq.q: Can you use the key before shutting down the valves?
faq.answer: Use the Console Key after the valves are shut down and the gauges read zero. Trying the active console risks a mechanical backfire.

angles.text: The Venture Company uses custom keyed locks to protect delicate engineering prototypes like the samophlange from competitors.
Taking the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles helps disrupt the Venture Company's exploitative industrial work in the heart of the Barrens.
